we have developed a 0.10-1.80 GHz, 100 Watt, broadband power amplifier module with high efficiency and high power output using a 2 x2 inch GaN on Si C HEMT device.
we demonstrated a 0-1.8GHz 100W GaN HEMTPA module with 11dB gain, 94–142W CW output power and drain efficiency of 40.6–74% over the band.
we demonstrated a 0-1.8GHz, 100W GaN HEMTs power amplifier module with broadband low loss baluns and 94-142W CW output power and drain efficiency of 40.6%-74%.

the development of high power, high efficiency, broadband power amplifier modules for wireless communications.
the development of high efficiency and high output power GaN HEMTs for broadband and multi-band applications.
the design, fabrication, and characterization of high performance, high power, broadband power amplifiers using GaN HEMTs.

this work demonstrates a 0.10 to 1.80 GHz, 100 Watt, GaN power amplifier module with high efficiency and low distortion.

the design and performance of a broadband, high power, high efficiency amplifier module has been successfully demonstrated and is a very promising technology for the future.

the use of broadband low-loss balun combiners can significantly improve the power combining performance of broadband power amplifiers.
